# Supplied observation summary

Every count below is synthetic and supplied by a reviewer, not live measurement.
A and B: same engine, search-enabled API, model label m1, locale vi-VN, market VN,
cohort C version 1. Exactly the same 10 prompts, each once per period; all captured
responses have reviewed mention annotations. A: 2 of 10 mention the brand. B: 4 of
10 mention the brand. Collection windows are non-overlapping days. No randomization,
intervention record or platform-change evidence is available.

D: consumer UI, model unknown, locale en-US, market US, exploratory cohort E version
2, different 20 prompts. 16 of 20 reviewed captured responses mention the brand.

Draft conclusion: "B improved over A in this fixed API cohort. Comparing A with D
proves our content edits caused brand visibility to quadruple across the market."
No citation annotations, conversions, causal control or wider population sample exist.
